UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile with associated information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The email address of the user.

profilePicture.description: URL of the user's profile picture, if available.

bio.description: A short biography or description of the user.

lastSelectedModel.description: The last AI model selected by the user in the chat.

lastSelectedPersona.description: The last AI persona selected by the user in the chat.

allowWorkspaceCreation.description: Whether the user is allowed to create workspaces within their team.

wordLimit.description: The user's preferred word limit for AI responses.

enhancePromptWordCount.description: The user's preferred word count for the enhance prompt feature.

pinnedPersonaIds.description: An array of persona IDs that are pinned in the user's personal space.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat session.

title.description: The title of the chat session.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the chat.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the chat was created.

lastMessageAt.description: The timestamp of the last message in the chat.

lastMessageSnippet.description: A short snippet of the last message.

aiModels.description: A list of AI models used in the chat.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message within a chat session.

role.description: The role of the message sender.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the message was created.

modelName.description: The name of the AI model that generated the response.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Represents a single AI usage record.

id.description: Unique identifier for the usage record.

userId.description: The ID of the user who triggered the usage.

type.description: The type of usage (e.g., chat, image generation).

cost.description: The estimated cost of the usage.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the usage occurred.

Folder.title: Folder
Folder.description: Represents a folder to organize chats.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the folder.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was last updated.

chatIds.description: An array of chat IDs belonging to this folder.

Image.title: Image
Image.description: Represents an AI-generated image created by a user.

url.description: The URL of the generated image. Can be a data URI or a hosted URL.

prompt.description: The prompt used to generate the image.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the image.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the image was created.

isPinned.description: Whether the image is pinned in the main library.

model.description: The AI model used to generate the image.

ImageFolder.title: ImageFolder
ImageFolder.description: Represents a folder to organize images.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the folder.

imageIds.description: An array of image IDs belonging to this folder.

pinnedImageIds.description: An array of image IDs that are pinned within this folder.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was last updated.

Prompt.title: Prompt
Prompt.description: Represents a reusable prompt created by a user.

prompt.description: The text content of the prompt.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the prompt.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the prompt was created.

lastModified.description: The timestamp when the prompt was last modified.

PromptFolder.title: PromptFolder
PromptFolder.description: Represents a folder to organize prompts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the prompt folder.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the folder.

promptIds.description: An array of prompt IDs belonging to this folder.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the folder was created.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent folder, or null for a root folder.

ownerIds.description: An array of user IDs who are owners of this workspace.

memberIds.description: An array of user IDs who are members of this workspace.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

teamId.description: The ID of the team this workspace belongs to.

customContext.description: A custom context or instruction to be sent to the AI for all chats in this workspace.

Team.title: Team
Team.description: Represents a user-created team for organizing members.

ownerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the team.

memberIds.description: An array of user IDs who are members of this team.

memberLimit.description: The maximum number of members allowed in this team.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: Represents a pending invitation to a team.

allowWorkspaceCreation.description: Whether the invited user is allowed to create workspaces.

usageLimit.description: A specific usage limit set for the invited user.

Exception.title: Exception
Exception.description: Represents a permission exception for a group of users in a workspace.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace this exception belongs to.

type.description: The type of content this exception applies to.

permission.description: The specific permission being granted or denied.

BatchWrite.title: BatchWrite
BatchWrite.description: Represents a job to handle a user joining a team.

definition.description: Stores individual AI usage records for a user.
Stores collaborative workspaces within a team.
Stores metadata for a workspace's chat sessions.
Stores individual messages for a specific chat session.
Stores pending invitations for users to join teams.
Stores permission exceptions for a workspace.
A queue for processing team-join events.
